name: sekaitext
description: Project Sekai story translation and subtitle editing desktop application
author: SnowGlow-aww

scripts.build:all: npm run build:go && npm run build
scripts.android:dev: npm run android:core && node scripts/run-android-tauri.mjs dev
scripts.android:build: npm run android:core && node scripts/run-android-tauri.mjs build --apk --target aarch64 --ci && node scripts/verify-android-apk.mjs --expect-unsigned src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/release/app-universal-release-unsigned.apk
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:core && node scripts/run-android-tauri.mjs build --debug --apk --target aarch64 --ci && node scripts/verify-android-apk.mjs --expect-debug src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk/universal/debug/app-universal-debug.apk
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test scripts/build-mobile-core.test.mjs scripts/plugin-market-lib.test.mjs scripts/release-manifest-lib.test.mjs scripts/release-workflow.test.mjs scripts/run-android-tauri.test.mjs scripts/sign-android-qa.test.mjs scripts/verify-android-apk.test.mjs scripts/sync-version.test.mjs
